title: Solar power plant with battery storage in Dalanzadgad
description: Construction of a 15 MW solar photovoltaic plant with 5 MWh battery storage connected to the southern regional grid to replace diesel generation in the soum centres.
objectives: Increase the share of renewable energy and reduce greenhouse-gas emissions.

title: Нийслэлийн гэр хорооллын айл өрхийн сайжруулсан зуух, дулаалга
description: Гэр хорооллын 8,000 өрхийн гэрийн дулаалгыг сайжруулж, агаарын бохирдлыг бууруулах сайжруулсан зуух нийлүүлнэ.
objectives: Агаарын бохирдол болон дулааны алдагдлыг бууруулах.

title: Secondary school building No. 5 in Khan-Uul district
description: Construction of a 640-seat secondary school with gym and canteen to reduce overcrowding and the three-shift system.

title: School dormitory with rooftop solar and building insulation
description: Construction of a 150-bed dormitory for herder children. About 20% of the budget covers rooftop solar panels and external wall insulation to cut heating costs.
objectives: Provide safe accommodation for students from remote areas.

title: Expansion of coal-fired thermal power plant unit
description: Installation of an additional 150 MW coal-fired unit at the existing thermal power plant to meet peak winter demand.

title: Pasture restoration and sustainable grazing in Khangai region
ministry: Ministry of Food, Agriculture and Light Industry
description: Rehabilitate 40,000 ha of degraded rangeland through rotational grazing plans with herder groups, reseeding and water points.
objectives: Restore pasture productivity and increase herders' resilience to drought and dzud.

title: Хот хоорондын авто замын 120 км-ийн шинэчлэл
description: Хатуу хучилттай авто замын 120 км хэсгийг шинэчилж, гүүр, ус зайлуулах хоолой барина.

title: Electric bus fleet for Ulaanbaatar public transport
description: Procurement of 100 electric buses and charging depot to replace ageing diesel buses on the busiest routes.
objectives: Reduce air pollution and emissions from public transport.

title: Flood protection dams and early warning system in Selbe river
description: Construct flood protection dams along the Selbe river and install an automated flood early warning system for 12,000 residents.
objectives: Reduce flood disaster risk under changing climate.

title: Green Development Tower office complex
description: Construction of a new 12-storey office building for government agencies with conference halls and underground parking.
objectives: Provide modern office space; the project supports the Green Development Policy.

title: Aimag centre wastewater treatment plant
ministry: Ministry of Construction and Urban Development
description: Build a 6,000 m3/day wastewater treatment plant and reuse treated water for green areas.

title: Мод тарих "Тэрбум мод" үндэсний хөдөлгөөний ойжуулалт
description: Говийн бүсэд 2,500 га талбайд ой сэргээх, мод тарих, дусал услалтын систем суурилуулна.

title: Waste sorting and recycling facility
description: Build a waste sorting line and plastic recycling facility processing 200 tonnes per day, reducing landfill volume.
objectives: Promote circular economy and reduce landfill methane.

title: Soum hospital renovation
description: Renovate the soum hospital, replace medical equipment and add an isolation ward. Windows will be replaced during renovation.

title: New coal mine access railway
ministry: Ministry of Road and Transport Development
description: Construction of a 240 km railway to transport coal from the new coal mine to the border crossing.

title: Protected area management and wildlife monitoring in Khustai
description: Strengthen management of the specially protected area, rangers, wildlife monitoring and wetland restoration.
